results.title: US Sanctions Against ICC Draw UN Chief Guterres' Criticism As Eight Nations Defend Court's Independence & International Justice
results.description: UN chief Antonio Guterres and foreign ministers of eight nations criticised US sanctions against the International Criminal Court (ICC), warning they could undermine international justice. The countries reaffirmed their support for the court's independence and accountability for serious crimes.

results.title: 'Drishyam 3 The Conclusion' BO Day 9 [LIVE]: Ajay Devgn film eyes Rs 300 crore India net
results.description: Ajay Devgn’s crime thriller has entered its second weekend after crossing Rs. 400 crore in worldwide gross collections on Day 8. Following a Rs. 245.50 crore India net collection in its opening week, the film earned Rs. 14.50 crore on Day 8, taking its domestic net total to Rs. 260 crore. With Day 9 live collections. Two targets now stand out: Rs 300 crore India net, which needs about Rs 36.42 crore more, and a worldwide gross of Rs 415 to 420 crore.
